items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

items.title: Qualcomm, Micron, Sandisk, and AMD stocks sink, leading chip sector lower
items.summary: Qualcomm, Micron, and Arm Holdings were all trading lower on Thursday as chip stocks continued to slide.

items.title: Stock market today: Nasdaq plunges 5% as chip stocks sell off, Dow and S&P 500 give back post-election rally gains
items.summary: US stock futures split as the crosscurrents of a power shift in Washington, the war in Iran, earnings, and labor market data overlapped.

items.title: Amazon and Google Could Outperform Nvidia as AI Trade Enters New Phase, Says Joseph Carlson
items.summary: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) could outperform Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) as AI investors shift from companies selling the hardware to those turning it into revenue, YouTube investor Joseph Carlson argues. A day after Democrats swept Congress and data-center critics won key...

items.title: Sandisk Sinks 14%, Micron Down 10% as a Top Phone Chipmaker Blames Weak Sales on “Industry-Wide Memory Dynamics”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk fell 14% today after a top phone chipmaker said its handset chip revenue dropped 26%, citing memory prices. That report confirms what Sandisk’s own phone and PC numbers already showed.

items.title: Berkshire Has Gained 16% in About 5 Weeks
items.summary: Berkshire hit a record high with no press release, no filing, and no executive comment to explain it. Three days before earnings, one report could show whether buybacks and cash moves are driving the rally or whether it has outrun the facts.

items.title: SanDisk Slides 7%, Micron and Western Digital Fall 5% as Lawmaker’s Call for AI Pause Extends Memory Rout
items.summary: A single post on X from a freshly empowered Democrat is rattling the AI trade. Memory and storage stocks that rode data center demand to record quarters now face a policy threat, and one name is bleeding the most.

items.title: How Worried Should Investors Be About Micron Right Now?
items.summary: Micron's business has rarely looked stronger, with sold-out memory and record margins, yet a Texas election result just knocked billions off the stock. Can policy outside the company's control override the numbers that made it an AI favorite?
